title: Topology-aware gang placement: whole jobs inside one block, slices inside one rack
purpose: Through one queue on the topology-aware flavor, with more quota (256 GPUs) than the 128 GPUs exist so that only placement can hold a job back, submit in order: an 8-node job that requires one block, a 4-node job that requires one block with slices of 2 nodes that each require one rack, a second 8-node job that requires one block (no block has 8 free nodes left), and a 4-node job that only prefers one rack.

steps.display: kubectl apply -f pretrain.yaml   # 8 pods x 8 GPUs, topology=network.ds17.io/block
kubectl apply -f finetune.yaml   # 4 pods x 8 GPUs, topology=network.ds17.io/block, slice_topology=network.ds17.io/rack, slice_size=2
kubectl apply -f pretrain-2.yaml   # 8 pods x 8 GPUs, topology=network.ds17.io/block
kubectl apply -f flex.yaml   # 4 pods x 8 GPUs, preferred=network.ds17.io/rack
where each job's pods landed (node labels network.ds17.io/block and rack)
steps.output:
pretrain    admitted True  pods 8/8  blocks ['b1']  racks [('b1-r1', 4), ('b1-r2', 4)]
finetune    admitted True  pods 4/4  blocks ['b2']  racks [('b2-r1', 4)]
pretrain-2  admitted False pods 0/8  blocks []  racks []
flex        admitted True  pods 4/4  blocks ['b2']  racks [('b2-r2', 4)]

couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: topology "ds17-fabric" allows to fit only 4 out of 8 pod(s); all pods must fit in a single "network.ds17.io/block" topology domain. Total nodes: 16; excluded: resource "nvidia.com/gpu": 12

checks.description: the first 8-node job runs entirely inside one block
checks.because: podset-required-topology: block; Kueue picks a block with 8 free nodes and pins each pod to a node in it.

checks.description: the sliced job runs in one block, with every rack holding a whole number of 2-node slices
the second 8-node job waits, holding nothing, because no block has 8 free nodes
checks.because: Required topology waits for a domain rather than spreading the job.

checks.description: the job that only prefers a rack is admitted anyway, in the smallest domain that fits
checks.because: podset-preferred-topology tries one rack and falls back to a wider domain; BestEffortFIFO lets it pass the waiting job.
